details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that reports an install event to a callback endpoint. Its postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, and requiring the package (index.js) triggers the same beacon; both send an HTTP POST to hxxp://13[.]140[.]137[.]222[.]8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing the package name, host name, install path, working directory and npm/node user agent, plus an `x-beacon-package` header identifying the package. The package collects no credentials, no environment variable values, no files and no wallet data; it is a no-op compatibility shim whose exported members all return empty objects, and it declares itself in its README as an authorized dependency-confusion test. Callback IOC: 13[.]140[.]137[.]222:8787 (path /_ah/dc).
